== Acquisition ==
* Originally found in [[Chest of the Final Room]] and [[Superior Buried Treasure]].

== Currency for ==
{{Vendor query table|currency=Gray Market Black Diamond}}

== Notes ==
* Removed from loot tables in the game as part of the [[Game updates/2017-11-07|November 7th, 2017]] update. It was introduced in error, as it did nothing and was used in no recipes.
** This item was originally called, "Black Diamond", and suffered a less descriptive name change ("((601427))") after its replacement. It was not the same Black Diamond introduced with [[Heart of Thorns]].
* Can be exchanged at Path of Fire merchants with the "Gray Market Diamond Exchange" tab for the [[Black Diamond|useful version]].
